import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/nls_bmi_processed.csv')

# Define the independent variables (time preference factors)
X = df[['DISSAVED', 'SAMESAVE']]

# Define the dependent variable (BMI)
y = df['BMI']

# Add a constant to the model (intercept)
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Fit the linear regression model
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

# Print the summary of the model
model.summary()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, linregress

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/nls_bmi_processed.csv')

# Check the correlation between BMI and DISSAVED
corr_dissaved, _ = pearsonr(df['BMI'], df['DISSAVED'])
print(f"Correlation between BMI and DISSAVED: {corr_dissaved}")

# Check the correlation between BMI and SAMESAVE
corr_samesave, _ = pearsonr(df['BMI'], df['SAMESAVE'])
print(f"Correlation between BMI and SAMESAVE: {corr_samesave}")

# Perform linear regression for BMI on DISSAVED
slope_dissaved, intercept_dissaved, r_value_dissaved, p_value_dissaved, std_err_dissaved = linregress(df['DISSAVED'], df['BMI'])
print(f"Regression for BMI on DISSAVED: slope={slope_dissaved}, p-value={p_value_dissaved}")

# Perform linear regression for BMI on SAMESAVE
slope_samesave, intercept_samesave, r_value_samesave, p_value_samesave, std_err_samesave = linregress(df['SAMESAVE'], df['BMI'])
print(f"Regression for BMI on SAMESAVE: slope={slope_samesave}, p-value={p_value_samesave}")
